comparison.objective: Candidate removes and contains insert tangs; record clears a paper-cutter bed and lowers the blade arm until its safety latch catches.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate tests precision impact, lateral-load control, and tiny-fragment collection; record tests clearing, articulated-arm operation, and latch engagement. Specs are absent.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires four valid fractures and an undamaged retained assembly; record requires a clear bed and latched blade arm, but detailed thresholds are not supplied.
comparison.reason: Securing a cutter through an articulated latch tests a different mechanism and outcome from breaking sacrificial insert tangs.
